name: Blind
doc: Blind (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks), each a prim-model layout at an effect point of the action's target (followed for 20 ticks, then left there), two of its objects drawn as additive quads; a screen flash all the tasks raise (the highest wins) and three screen fades; the target takes the result at tick 32 and the task ends with its layout.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layout's blended vertex frames (after the three target nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn; each target task's clock: its sound, its result (draws nothing)

parts.title: Layout
parts.doc: The layout played on the action's target, at one of its effect points; the task ends with it

parts.title: Flash
parts.doc: The screen flash all the target tasks raise, and the screen fades they start

groups.label: Additive objects
groups.doc: These two objects of the layout are drawn as their textured quads only, additive (-1: none)

groups.label: Fade ticks
groups.doc: A screen fade starts at each of these target ticks

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: Bone
params.doc: The target's effect point the layout is at (0xF0 and up: the engine's named points)

params.label: Follow until
params.doc: The layout follows that point while the target tick is below this, then stays

params.label: Depth shift
params.doc: The renderers' depth >> this picks the drawing bucket

params.label: From
params.doc: The flash rises from this target tick (Up a tick)

params.label: Peak
params.doc: ...to this one, then falls (Down a tick)

params.label: Up
params.doc: Its level a tick while it rises

params.label: Down
params.doc: Its level a tick while it falls

tasks.doc: One per action: the screen flash level raised; the layout at the action's target's effect point (taken while the tick is below 20, then left there), each object's offset added to it through the camera (record flags 0x800: the offset turned by the object's rotation first; 0x200: the anchor through the camera + the offset as is; 0x100: scaled by a diagonal matrix), drawn by the engine's renderer, objects 0 and 3 as additive quads; then its sound at the target's effect position, the screen fades, the result; it ends with the layout.
